name: Staff chat badges: .gm mod chat, .gm cm chat and .gm admin chat mark the staff member's chat
contract: The 3.3.5a client only renders the GM, DEV, AFK and DND chat tags, so a moderator, community manager or administrator badge is carried in the chat text: with .gm mod chat on the server sends |cff33bbff<MOD>|r in front of the text, with .gm cm chat on |cff33bbff<CM>|r, with .gm admin chat on |cff33bbff<ADMIN>|r. The client UI turns that prefix into a badge in front of the name.
Only one staff tag is active at a time: turning one on replaces the other, and turning off a tag that is not active changes nothing. With every tag off the text arrives unchanged.

The MOD command needs the Moderator command role (permission 1009): an ordinary player cannot use it. The CM and ADMIN commands need the Administrator command role (permissions 1010 and 1011): a moderator cannot use them either.
Nobody can fake the badge: a player's message that carries the prefix itself does not arrive with it.

steps.label: An ordinary player cannot turn the moderator tag on
An ordinary player cannot turn the community manager tag on
An ordinary player cannot turn the administrator tag on
A moderator cannot turn the community manager tag on
A moderator cannot turn the administrator tag on
Before any tag, the moderator whispers
Without a tag the text arrives unchanged
The moderator turns the moderator tag on
THE TAG: the whisper arrives with the MOD prefix
and not without it
The moderator turns the moderator tag off
With the tag off the text arrives unchanged again
A player types the MOD prefix into a whisper
then whispers normally
The normal whisper arrives
THE GUARD: the faked prefix never arrives
An administrator turns the moderator tag on
then the community manager tag, which replaces it
Turning off the inactive moderator tag changes nothing
Ask for the community manager tag state
The community manager tag is on
Ask for the moderator tag state
The moderator tag was replaced
The administrator tag replaces the community manager tag
Ask for the administrator tag state
The administrator tag is on
Ask for the community manager tag state again
The community manager tag was replaced
The administrator turns the administrator tag off
Ask for the administrator tag state again
The administrator tag is off
